metadata.title: Pre-UniTime Manual Legacy Schedule Baseline
metadata.description: Authoritative simulation of human-generated manual timetable baseline for ITB multi-campus engineering programs (IF, SI, EL, TI, TPB) exhibiting authentic human scheduling flaws prior to UniTime automated timetabling adoption.

flaws.title: Instructor Simultaneous Double-Booking
flaws.description: Lead lecturer Achmad Imam Kistijantoro, S.T., M.Sc., Ph.D. is scheduled to teach two different lecture classes simultaneously on Monday 08:00 - 09:40 in separate classrooms (LTV 7601 and LTV 7602), creating a physical human impossibility.

instructor.name: Achmad Imam Kistijantoro, S.T., M.Sc., Ph.D.

unitimeResolution.strategy: Enforce DIFF_TIME distribution constraint on shared instructor
unitimeResolution.action: Reschedule IF3110_K01 to Tuesday 10:45 - 12:25 in LTV 7602

flaws.title: Room Simultaneous Double-Booking
flaws.description: Classroom LTV 7601 is simultaneously assigned to two distinct classes on Wednesday 10:00 - 11:40 (IF2130 K01 and TI2101 K02), creating a physical room collision.

unitimeResolution.action: Reassign TI2101_K02 to LTIII 3102 (home department building) on Wednesday 10:00 - 11:40

flaws.title: Inverted Precedence (Lab Preceding Prerequisite Theory Lecture)
flaws.description: For course IF2110 (Algoritma dan Struktur Data), the laboratory session IF2110 L01 is scheduled on Monday 13:00 - 15:30, whereas the prerequisite theory lecture IF2110 K01 is scheduled on Thursday 08:00 - 10:30 (nearly 3 days later). Students are forced to execute practical laboratory assignments before receiving the foundational theoretical instruction.

distributionConstraint.rule: Lecture (IF2110 K01) must precede Lab (IF2110 L01) in the weekly cycle

unitimeResolution.strategy: Enforce PRECEDENCE distribution constraint (Lecture -> Lab sequence)
unitimeResolution.action: Schedule IF2110_K01 (Lecture) on Monday 08:00 - 10:30 and IF2110_L01 (Lab) on Thursday 13:30 - 16:00

flaws.title: Impossible Cross-Campus Travel (10-Minute Gap for 18.4 km Trip)
flaws.description: For cohort SI_2024 on Thursday, class SI2103 K01 ends at Kampus Ganesha (LTIII 3101) at 11:30, and the very next class SI2102 L01 starts at Kampus Jatinangor (KOICA 201) at 11:40. The 10-minute transition gap is physically impossible for an 18.72 km geodesic (27 km driving) inter-city commute requiring a minimum transit time of 60.0 minutes.

unitimeResolution.strategy: Enforce travel time matrix & campus-day clustering constraints
unitimeResolution.action: Shift SI2102_L01 to Thursday 13:30 - 16:00, creating a 120-minute travel buffer

flaws.title: Severe Room Under-Utilization (20 Students in 200-Seat Amphitheatre)
flaws.description: A small laboratory section IF2130 L01 (20 students) is assigned to GKUB 9002 (Gedung Kuliah Umum Barat Amphitheatre, capacity 200), resulting in an inefficient 10.0% seat occupancy and wasting 180 seats in the university's premier large-hall instructional venue.

unitimeResolution.strategy: Optimal room-to-class capacity matching (minimizing wasted seat-hours)
unitimeResolution.action: Reassign IF2130_L01 to LTV 7603 (seminar room, capacity 20, 100.0% occupancy)

flaws.title: Severe Room Overcrowding (55 Students in 40-Seat Room)
flaws.description: Lecture class TI2101 K01 with 55 enrolled students is assigned to KOICA 201 (capacity 40 seats), producing an unacceptable 137.5% overcrowding ratio where 15 students have no desks, creating a severe building safety and pedagogical violation.

unitimeResolution.action: Reassign TI2101_K01 to LTIII 3101 (capacity 60, 91.7% occupancy) in home department building

flaws.title: Student Dead-Time Gap (4-Hour Idle Window for Cohort TI_2024)
flaws.description: On Tuesday, cohort TI_2024 finishes lecture TI2102 K01 at 08:40 and has no other academic activity until recitation TI2101 R01 starts at 12:40. This creates an excessive 4.0-hour (240-minute) unproductive dead-time gap where students are stranded on campus with no instructional engagement.

unitimeResolution.strategy: Schedule compactness optimization & student idle window minimization
unitimeResolution.action: Reschedule TI2101_R01 to Tuesday 09:00 - 09:50 immediately after TI2102_K01
